useMdns.label: Use mDNS
useMdns.help: Discover the gateway on the local network via mDNS (_hvac-open-api._tcp). When enabled, the adapter finds the current gateway address automatically at startup, so the host does not have to be updated when the IP changes.

acceptSelfSigned.label: Accept self-signed gateway certificates
acceptSelfSigned.help: Accept the gateway's own (self-signed) HTTPS certificate, as used by the MX400. Disable if you want strict certificate verification.

accessToken.label: Access Token (pre-generated)
accessToken.help: Alternatively provide a pre-generated access token from the gateway

requestTimeout.label: Request timeout (ms)
requestTimeout.help: Per-request timeout. Increase if the gateway is slow to answer.

corePaths.label: Paths to poll
corePaths.help: One path per line. The state id is derived automatically: the first path segment becomes the channel, all following segments are flattened with underscores, e.g. /system/sensors/temperatures/outdoor_t1 → system.sensors_temperatures_outdoor_t1. Lines starting with # are ignored.

pollInterval.label: Polling interval (s)
pollInterval.help: How often the core values are read (default 60 s)

signalsFilter.label: Signals filter (regular expression)
signalsFilter.help: Required to read signals. Empty means no signals are polled. Use ".*" to read all, or e.g. ^/signals/(SC|HC1) to narrow it down.

signalsInterval.label: Signals polling interval (s)
signalsInterval.help: Slower interval for the appliance signals, e.g. 300 s = 5 minutes

enableEnergy.label: Enable energy monitoring
enableEnergy.help: Read cumulative energy and today/this-month consumption/production from the gateway (heat pump, electric heater and totals). Disable if your gateway does not provide the emon endpoints.

energyInterval.label: Energy interval (s)
energyInterval.help: How often the energy values are read (default 3600 s = 1 hour). Energy requests are heavier, so a slow cadence is recommended.
